caption:
Kya construction site par har baar ply ka nuksan hona lazmi hai? Bilkul nahi!

Switch kijiye VAJRA PP shuttering sheet par jo hai 100% waterproof aur lightweight. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur har dhalai ka kharcha kam karti hai.

Apne thekedar ya mistri ko ye reel share kijiye.
